headline: New DarkSword spyware variant uncovered, affecting unpatched iPhones
summary: Security researchers have identified P7 DarkSword, a new variant of spyware targeting unpatched iPhones. This malware is linked to the previously discovered DarkSword exploit chain.
details: iVerify has released a report detailing P7 DarkSword, a new variant of malware associated with the DarkSword iPhone exploit chain. This discovery highlights ongoing threats to iPhone users who have not applied the latest security updates.

The DarkSword exploit chain was initially uncovered earlier this year, indicating a persistent effort by threat actors to target iOS devices. P7 DarkSword represents an evolution of this sophisticated spyware, posing a risk to user data and privacy.
caption:
A new, sophisticated spyware variant, P7 DarkSword, is targeting unpatched iPhones.

iVerify has released a report detailing P7 DarkSword, a new variant of malware associated with the DarkSword iPhone exploit chain. This discovery highlights ongoing threats to iPhone users who have not applied the latest security updates.

The DarkSword exploit chain was initially uncovered earlier this year, indicating a persistent effort by threat actors to target iOS devices. P7 DarkSword represents an evolution of this sophisticated spyware, posing a risk to user data and privacy.
